rows.title_full: AN ACT PENALIZING THE PILFERAGE OF WATER, PROVIDING PENALTIES THEREOF AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract: "Anti-Water Pilferage Act 2000." Rationale: Current reports indicate that at least 32% of most residents remain waterless or lack water. It further shows that, more than 50% of water distributed not only in the metropolis are still lost through leaks,illegal connection and wrong metering. One-half of non-revenue rates was attributed to leaks while the other half was caused by pilferage and wrong metering.

rows.author: C027
rows.title_full: AN ACT DISQUALIFYING FROM FILING A CERTIFICATE OF CANDIDACY FOR ANY POSITION IN ANY NATIONAL OR LOCAL ELECTION PERSONS CHARGED WITH AND DETAINED FOR OR CONVICTED OF NON-BAILABLE OFFENSES
rows.abstract: Rationale: This bill seeks to disqualify from seeking any elective office all persons charged with and detained for or convicted of offenses which are non-bailable under existing laws.>Constitue ncies have suffered enough from deprivation of representation in government due to the detention of their elective public officials as a consequence of the latter's being charged with and detained for non-bailable offenses. It is submitted that this piece of legislation will prevent the recurrence of similar incidents in the future.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on SUFFRAGE AND ELECTORAL REFORMS since 2000-02-15

rows.author: A018
rows.title_full: AN ACT DISQUALIFYING ANY CANDIDATE, WHOSE NAME IS NOT INCLUDED IN THE CENSUS OF MAY, 2000 TO RUN FOR ANY ELECTIVE POSITION IN THE YEAR 2001 NATIONAL AND LOCAL ELECTIONS, AMENDING FOR THE PURPOSE BATAS PAMBANSA BLG. 881, OTHERWISE KNOWN AS THE OMNIBUS ELECTION CODE OF THE PHILIPPINES, AS AMENDED AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract: The primary objective of this piece of legislation is to preclude pseudo-resident s and transient residents from insidiously filing their certificates of candidacy in any loclaity of their choice and convenience during political election time. Besides, a census undertaken with replete demography will serve well as an alternative to the much opposed concept of a unified citizens' identification system.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on SUFFRAGE AND ELECTORAL REFORMS since 2000-02-15

rows.title_full: AN ACT CONVERTING THE NATIONAL PRINTING OFFICE INTO A GOVERNMENT CORPORATION TO BE KNOWN AS THE `NATIONAL PRINTING CORPORATION', DEFINING ITS POWERS AND FUNCTIONS, APPROPRIATING FUNDS THEREFOR AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract: "The National Printing Corporaiton Act of 2000". To further strengthen the NPO, this measure seeks to convert it to a government-corp oration wholly owned by the National Government, which will in turn give the NPO more leeway in the use of its income and at the same time provide a heftier return on the National Government's investments.

rows.abstract: This act requires the Board of Pardons and Parole which is udner the Department of Justice to PUBLISH the names of convicts, their offenses and the places where committed, recommended for executive clemency, in newspapers of national and general circulation at least thirty (30) days prior to its submittal of the list of recommendees to the Office of the President in order to ALLOW PUBLIC REACTION which could guide Presdidential action thereon.
